items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: But Donnie D. the trumpet player, you know.

ctx.x: What about, let's see. Who are some of the other bands you played with?
Oh, I played with two, three brass bands off and on like that. But Donnie D. the trumpet player, you know.
Well, who are some of them? Well, I think DeRica. I worked with him a while. I believe. What about DeJalma Gagne?
